items.docs: Returns outstanding composition of Synthetix debt pool. If `key` query parameter is not provided it returns an array of objects (all assets). If `key` query parameter is provided it returns an object (with requested asset). If `net` query parameter is not provided it returns combined data for both networks. If `net` query parameter is provided it returns data for requested network.
Returns SNX staking ratio between L1 and L2.
